description: Shop prices of one product version side by side in the locale's market on the site that lists it (cheapest total first, out of stock last; price, shipping, stock, when checked and the shop link), plus the same version's best price in that site's other markets.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

product.description: The product's page URL (any site, any language), or its id from search_products together with `site`.

site.description: The site key from search_products or list_sites; not needed with a page URL.

version.description: A version id (colour, size, …); default: the version with the cheapest offer.

name: compare_prices
title: Shops for one product
